reviews.title: Outstanding for 4K Video Editing in DaVinci Resolve 19
reviews.comment: The PNY GeForce RTX 4070 Ti Super has been a game-changer for my video editing workflow in DaVinci Resolve 19. Working with 4K footage, especially with Fusion effects, used to slow down my system, but this card handles everything smoothly. With 16GB of memory, it’s powerful enough to breeze through complex Fusion compositions without lag, even with multiple layers and effects. The triple-fan cooling is highly effective, keeping the card cool and quiet even during longer rendering sessions. The RGB lighting is a nice bonus, but the real win here is the performance boost for 4K editing. If you're serious about video production, this card is absolutely worth the investment.

reviews.title: A streak of lightning
reviews.comment: *panting* I swear *catching breath* I will *still wheezing* start working out more. So I can keep up with this thing. I mean, it's ok. Just kind of on the mediocre side of 'why did I spend this much money?' But once you're running an RTX game, or also in my case a VR game running wirelessly to my Oculus (getting 60fps) with no lag (ok, maybe when my kiddo hops on Minecraft),..... my English teacher told me I'm bad about run-on sentences. But you'll be able to run on for hours with this beast! :D It's relatively cool and quiet, the support bracket was easy to install (and necessary), and my motherboard has build-in RGB controls, so that coordinated with the rest of the rainbow in the case🌈. It's like a LGBTQ+ pride festival in a cyberpunk city in there.
